what: In the section, a photo card follows the cursor late with 1s power4 (card center on the cursor), tilts by how far it moved horizontally (Δx/4 deg), and the inner photo, scaled 1.2x, shifts ±8% opposite to the motion (horizontal .6s · vertical .7s power2). Each time the cursor travels 300px it switches to the next photo, and after a 66ms pause the tilt and shift return to 0. The card goes from transparent to clear while the section enters the screen from 5% → 30%

options.every: Cursor travel distance (px) that swaps the photo, default 300
options.tilt: Divisor that turns horizontal movement into tilt, default 4 (Δx/4 deg)
options.settle: Time until settling upright after stopping (ms), default 66
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Following card (child) — placed at the center of the panel
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo group inside a card (child) — the [data-fx-part inside it=Shows each img] one at a time

note: Enabled only with (hover: hover) and width 1024 or more, as in the original. The card sits at the panel center (fixed to the screen), and the panel is cut with clip-path so nothing is drawn outside it. The card size could not be measured from the original, so the consuming css decides it.
